name: Standby verify (scratch restore on a standby)

knobs.note: timeout on the one bin/state-restore.sh dry run a standby verify run makes; rc 124 records the run as fail 'timed out'. Keep it below the worker's standby_verify_claim_ttl_s settings row (fallback 1800), or a slow pull is re-offered while it is still running. Read by bin/standby-verify.sh.

no static default — the script uses /tmp. Where bin/standby-verify.sh makes its scratch dir (mktemp -d <dir>/standby-verify.XXXXXX). A dir that resolves to /root/harness or under it is refused with exit 2 and one ALERTS line. A path and a test seam, so NOT settable from the control plane. Read by bin/standby-verify.sh as ${STANDBY_VERIFY_TMPDIR:-/tmp}.
